results.title: Quill — the Ink Spirit
results.visible: An invented being made of dark navy ink: a rounded glossy body with large pale violet eyes and a small smile, a swept-back crest of ink shaped like feathers rising from its head, a cape of ink with silver edging flaring out behind, and a puddle of ink under its feet with drops flying around it. It holds a tall silver-nibbed quill pen upright in one hand, taller than itself. Standing, front-facing, the body compact and the crest, cape and pen all reaching upward and outward from it.
results.prompt: a little spirit made of ink holding a quill pen

analysis.subject: little ink spirit holding a quill pen
analysis.composition: A compact, upright figure with a rounded head and body, standing firmly with one arm akimbo and the other holding a large quill pen, creating a balanced and confident stance.
architecture: rounded head with large expressive eyes
small body with short limbs
ink-like fluid forms extending from head and cape edges
cape flowing around the body with ink splash effects
quill pen held upright in right hand
decorative silver markings on face, chest, and cape
analysis.proportion: The head and eyes are exaggeratedly large compared to the small, rounded body, emphasizing cuteness and expressiveness.
analysis.gesture: The figure reads as one coherent, confident gesture with a slight forward lean and a raised arm holding the quill, suggesting readiness and charm.

abstraction.note: The silver details and facial expression should be suggested abstractly rather than literally drawn.

gesture.note: The figure stands confidently with a slight forward lean, one arm akimbo and the other raised holding the quill, conveying readiness and charm.

revealOnly: silver patterns on cape and face
plan.movement: The figure moves with playful, confident gestures, the cape and ink splashes flowing fluidly as it raises the quill with charm.

decision.reason: The ink splash shapes around the cape and body require a new visual relationship to express their fluid, irregular, and dynamic form beyond simple enclosure.

extensions.name: splash-enclosure
extensions.meaning: an irregular, fluid enclosure that extends from a mass with dynamic, splash-like protrusions
extensions.whyNeeded: current 'enclosure' term implies a smooth surrounding shape, but ink splashes have irregular, droplet-like extensions that break smooth silhouette
extensions.expresses: the visual relationship of fluid, dynamic splash shapes surrounding or extending from a mass
extensions.visualEffect: adds irregular, droplet-like protrusions breaking the silhouette to convey fluidity and splash effect
examples: ink splashes, water splashes, paint splatters around a figure
